---
title: "Personal Visualization Journey"
---

Loading Data

```{r}
screen_time_data <- read_csv('Personal Visualization Data - Sheet1.csv')
```
Wrangling Data

```{r}
screen_time_data <- screen_time_data |>
  mutate(week_day = wday(date))
```

Visualization

```{r}
screen_time_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = screen_time, color = week_day)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_c()
```
